market: Global Digital Twin Market - Infrastructure, Utilities & Smart Cities
market_definition: Global Digital Twin Market — Infrastructure, Utilities & Smart Cities. Product / technology: Twin type: asset twin, network twin, city twin; enabling technology: IoT, AI/ML, BIM, GIS, drone/LiDAR, cloud, edge computing; visualization: 2D/3D dashboards, BIM viewer, 3D city model. Business models: Twin-platform subscription, reality-capture service, BIM-to-twin integration, IoT integration, simulation and scenario modeling, managed digital-twin operations. Applications: Design and construction, operations and maintenance, predictive maintenance, asset performance, safety, sustainability, urban planning, remote monitoring. End users: Construction, real estate, utilities, telecom, transportation, manufacturing, government/smart cities, energy and utilities. Geography: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, Middle East & Africa; India smart-city and infrastructure programs as a dedicated focus. Digital-twin applications commonly include predictive maintenance, performance monitoring, and design/development use cases.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR / CHANNEL PARTNER DEFINITION (hardware + software market): this market sells both hardware and software, so two shapes qualify - a stocking or authorized DISTRIBUTOR buying hardware in volume and reselling it, and a CHANNEL PARTNER, value-added reseller or SYSTEM INTEGRATOR that resells, bundles or implements another vendor's platform, software or modules. EXCLUDED: manufacturers, OEMs and their sales subsidiaries; vendors selling their own platform; consultancies with nothing to resell; and consumer-only retailers. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
